display.summary: First-run setup uploads work again; the always-visible search hides its icon; the Options tour shows the tab strip.
highlights: The setup wizard's logo and font pickers upload again (the setup gate had bounced them).
With search set to always visible, the desktop titlebar no longer shows a search icon beside the field.
The Options tour introduces the section tabs instead of skipping the cards hidden behind them.
Eleven stale browser tests repaired; the whole e2e suite passes again.
